theorems.name: Submission.rsdic_imrep_ae_tangent_orient_of_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U B C : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet B → MeasurableSet C → B ⊆ R.carrier → B ⊆ C → C ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (C ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict B), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (R.orient x) Q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
